record.title: Uganda national COVID passenger border restrictions
record.scope: National land and water passenger entry/exit restrictions
record.crossings: National land and water passenger entry/exit restrictions
record.movement: Passengers by road, water, foot and bicycle; cargo allowed.
record.exceptions: Cargo drivers and accompanying crew not exceeding three. Separately documented humanitarian asylum admissions include Gulajo/Golajo/Guladjo and Mount Zeu from July 1–3, 2020; the June 18, 2021 partners statement reports several authorised exceptions. These do not establish uniform ordinary asylum reopening.
record.status_observation: Uganda Tourism Board confirms general leisure/business travel permission from October 1, 2020. UNHCR year-end 2020 reporting separately says asylum borders remained officially closed with exceptions and informal entry; the June 18, 2021 partners statement describes the qualified regime. No universal asylum restoration date is established.
record.official_rationale: Prevent COVID-19 importation and enforce quarantine.
record.uncertainty: Retain 22 March 2020 midday–1 October 2020 general policy timing. Local Katuna denials reported late 21 March. Humanitarian admission at Gulajo/Golajo and Mount Zeu 1–3 July interrupted closure for DRC asylum-seekers; general reopening does not prove asylum admission restored.
